evidence: truncate_message is a method of DXLogHandler and is reached from emit() in the same class. Its only input is the message. _bytes2utf8 decodes with errors ignored, so the JSON length of the decoded prefix never decreases as the prefix grows; the largest prefix within the limit is therefore the one the byte-by-byte loop stopped at.
notes: C7.S1. The loop dropped one byte per pass and re-serialised the whole 8 KB string each time, which is linear in the excess bytes times the string length. A binary search over the prefix length finds the same cut in about log2(8000) serialisations. The return value is unchanged.
